# Sofie Panfilova — Clinical Dietitian for Women

> Sofia Panfilova (brand "Sofie Panfilova / Health as a Project") is a clinical dietitian for women with 10+ years of experience. Personalised nutrition programmes based on blood tests and hormonal profile: menopause, HRT, GLP-1, pregnancy & breastfeeding, metabolism, CGM. In-person in Limassol (Cyprus) and online worldwide. Education: 1. Lékařská fakulta, Univerzita Karlova (Prague); MBA in healthcare management (ESBM); NESTA certification.

## Services

- [Express diagnostics (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/express-diagnostics.html): 30-min nutrition triage or written review of lab results. €97.
- [Nutrition consultation (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/nutrition-consultation.html): 1.5-hour online consultation with a 2-week follow-up. €250.
- [Pregnancy & breastfeeding consultation (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/pregnancy-consultation.html): nutrition support per trimester and during lactation. €250.
- [CGM glucose monitoring (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/cgm-monitoring.html): 2-week continuous glucose monitoring with daily support. €350.
- [Nutritional support, 8 weeks (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/nutritional-support.html): 8-week programme with weekly sessions. €750.
- [Health as a Project (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/services/health-as-a-project.html): flagship 6-month longevity programme. €1500.

## Free guides (email-gated)

- [5 key blood tests for women (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/guides/5-tests.html): the five blood markers that reveal the most about hormonal and metabolic health.
- [Omega-3 checklist (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/guides/omega3.html): how to pick an effective omega-3 supplement — form, dose, quality.
- [Pregnancy & breastfeeding nutrition guide (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/guides/pregnancy-nutrition-guide.html): full nutrition guide for pregnancy and lactation.

## Blog

- [Coffee during pregnancy (EN)](https://sofievp.com/en/blog/coffee-pregnancy.html): how much caffeine is safe, and when to cut it.
